before.question: If the help paragraph ID changes to other-help but describedby stays answer-help, what breaks?
choices: The label becomes a submit button.
The input automatically finds the nearest paragraph.
The input’s description reference no longer resolves.
before.explanation: ID references are exact strings. Nearby text is not automatically substituted for a missing referenced ID.

after.question: You rename the help id to other-help but leave aria-describedby="answer-help". What breaks?
choices: The label becomes a submit button.
The input finds the nearest paragraph automatically.
The input no longer points to the help paragraph.
after.explanation: The reference must match the help paragraph’s exact id. Being nearby does not connect the text.
